name: p-simtor
description: Agent Skill: scientifically verified, interactive physics simulations as self-contained HTML instruments.

scripts.test:browser: npm run -s examples && node scripts/psim.mjs check examples/three-body/three-body.html && node scripts/psim.mjs check examples/solar-system/solar-system.html && node scripts/psim.mjs check examples/proton-magnetic-field/proton-magnetic-field.html && node scripts/psim.mjs check examples/blackbody/blackbody.html && node scripts/psim.mjs check examples/black-hole/black-hole.html && node scripts/psim.mjs check examples/galaxy/galaxy.html && node scripts/psim.mjs check examples/gps-relativity/gps-relativity.html
scripts.examples: node scripts/psim.mjs gravity --out examples/three-body/three-body.html && node scripts/psim.mjs gravity --preset solar-system --out examples/solar-system/solar-system.html && node scripts/psim.mjs build examples/proton-magnetic-field/page.html --verify-module examples/proton-magnetic-field/physics.mjs --out examples/proton-magnetic-field/proton-magnetic-field.html && node scripts/psim.mjs build examples/blackbody/page.html --verify-module examples/blackbody/physics.mjs --out examples/blackbody/blackbody.html && node scripts/psim.mjs build examples/black-hole/page.html --verify-module examples/black-hole/physics.mjs --out examples/black-hole/black-hole.html && node scripts/psim.mjs build examples/galaxy/page.html --verify-module examples/galaxy/physics.mjs --out examples/galaxy/galaxy.html && node scripts/psim.mjs build examples/gps-relativity/page.html --verify-module examples/gps-relativity/physics.mjs --out examples/gps-relativity/gps-relativity.html
